about: Starter list of common macOS adware / potentially unwanted program families, compiled from public removal guides. Matching is heuristic: 'paths' are checked for existence, 'bundleIds' are compared with apps and extensions, 'nameHints' are lowercase substrings matched against app names, launchd labels, file names and browser extension names. Edit freely.

families.name: Genieo
families.description: Search hijacker that installs a browser extension and changes your homepage.

families.name: MacKeeper
families.description: Aggressively marketed 'cleaner' that has been widely reported as scareware.

families.name: Pirrit
families.description: Adware that injects ads into web pages, often through a proxy or launch agent.

families.name: Adload
families.description: Large adware family that installs randomly named launch agents running from hidden folders in Application Support. Many variants are caught by the hidden-location heuristic rather than by name.

families.name: Shlayer
families.description: Trojan downloader usually disguised as a fake Flash Player installer; drops other adware such as Bundlore.

families.name: Bundlore
families.description: Adware bundler that installs search-hijacking browser extensions.

families.name: VSearch (Downlite)
families.description: Injects ads into web pages via a system framework and a helper named Jack.

families.name: SearchMine
families.description: Browser hijacker that redirects searches through search-mine.net.

families.name: Crossrider
families.description: Adware framework that installs browser extensions and changes the homepage.

families.name: InstallCore
families.description: Adware installer bundling unwanted programs with free software.

families.name: Spigot / Searchme
families.description: Adware that changes browser search settings.

families.name: Advanced Mac Cleaner / Mac Auto Fixer
families.description: Potentially unwanted 'optimizer' apps that show exaggerated problems to sell a license.
